annotations.text:
Dialed — first pass, dark athletic.
Phone screens left to right: Today, Fuel, Cook Day, Train, Body, Settings. Desktop below.
Above each screen: a Theme chip (dark / light) and an Accent chip (orange by default; lime and sky to compare).

The thread through every screen: the plan adapts.
Training day → carbs up. Weight trend → next week's calories. Off-plan meal → the rest of the day re-solves.
Day groups and cook days are settings, not assumptions — Mon–Wed / Thu–Sat / Sunday free is just the example. Meals are tagged batch or fresh; only batch meals reach Cook Day.
